measurementScope: One native acceptance launch; startup includes sentinel command/polling. Resize includes dispatcher/polling. Not a cold-start or comparative benchmark.
checks: Native window, PTY and routed text/Enter → real shell output
Native screen replay seeks historical text while the real shell continues; independent read-only renderer
Historical grid survives viewer resize without reflow
Profile output rule matches real shell output and exposes per-pane history
Real shell sixel / OSC1337 PNG / kitty RGBA render red / green / blue native pixels
macOS native menu tree configured; in-window menu hidden
Dark and light native render snapshots
Native shortcuts create tabs, nested panes and search
